newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian bonds soft, but off earlier lows.
newsitem.headline: Austrian bonds soft, but off earlier lows.

text.p: 1445 GMT - Austrian bonds recovered off the day's low to stand marginally softer on Thursday.
"We briefly dropped after the (German) M3 figures, but the market is proving to be surprisingly resilient," said one trader.
Market seen drifting sideways as investors lie in wait for next week's FOMC meeting.
German Bund future expected to meander around the 98-point level. "It'll only become dangerous once we fall under 97.60 points," said another trader.
* Benchmark 10-year 6.25 percent down 15 bps at 100.10 to yield 6.23 (6.21) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 100.05/15 to yield 6.24/22 percent.
* At the near end, five-year 5.25 percent bond maturing March 2001 down five at 101.25 to yield 5.19 (5.18) percent in bourse trade, quoted post-market at 101.17/27 to yield 5.21/19 percent.
* 10-year spread to German bunds steady at seven bps, five-year spread up one at 24 bps.
* December AGB future down 15 bps at 104.15 on volume of 582 contracts.
* Money market rates steady with 3-month VIBOR at 3.342 and overnight money at 2.99/3.24. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 254
